🎥🎬: Johnny English Strikes Again (2018)

When a cyberattack exposes the identities of undercover British agents around the world, MI7 is forced to bring retired agent Johnny English back into action. Despite his outdated methods and complete lack of modern technological skills, English is convinced he is the only man capable of stopping the threat.

Joined by his reluctant partner Bough, English begins chasing the mysterious hacker responsible for the attack. His investigation takes him from high-tech facilities to glamorous locations, but his old-school spy tactics repeatedly create chaos wherever he goes.

As the threat grows more dangerous, English must rely on his instincts, ridiculous gadgets, and sheer confidence to uncover the mastermind before Britain’s intelligence network is destroyed.

source_details.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
source_details.synopsis: Johnny English Strikes Again is a 2018 spy action comedy film directed by David Kerr and written by William Davies. It is the third instalment in the Johnny English film series and the sequel to Johnny English Reborn (2011). The film stars Rowan Atkinson as Johnny English, alongside Ben Miller, Olga Kurylenko, Jake Lacy and Emma Thompson. The film follows the titular MI7 agent who is called into action when every undercover operative is exposed in a cyber attack. The film was released in Australia on 20 September 2018 and in the United Kingdom on 5 October, by Universal Pictures. The film received mixed reviews from critics, and grossed $159 million against a $25 million budget.
